== iOS simulators

* Fixed an issue where *Set device timezone* failed on iOS simulators in manual sessions with the message *Cannot set the device time zone. Please try again.* The simulator now changes to the selected timezone.
* Each timezone change on an iOS simulator pauses the device screen for about 7 to 10 seconds and closes the app in the foreground. Relaunch the app to continue testing.

For details, see xref:manual-testing:device-controls.adoc[Device controls].
